title: OBSIDIA dark-mode restaurant suite: match eight mixed-lighting plate shots to one house white point, knock every menu tile onto one near-black backdrop, author the hero + vectorized mark + a print menu
grounding_note: Adapted from a real Upwork brief for a premium restaurant website (a Portugal-based boutique agency wanting a 'high-end, clean, modern-minimalist' site with a 'Dark Mode aesthetic' that 'focuses heavily on high-quality food photography', Home / Interactive Food Menu / Booking sections, mobile-responsive). The real post named no restaurant; it is laundered to a fictional fine-dining room, OBSIDIA, and the client stays an unnamed boutique studio whose own front-end developer builds the site (no real web-build tool named). The site build itself is out of Adobe-connector scope (no web layout, no from-scratch art), so the task is scoped to the brief's repeatedly-stressed pillar: the dark-mode food photography the whole site 'focuses heavily on', plus the printed menu the same photography feeds. REASONABLE ENRICHMENT to make the chain concrete, failable, and measurable: the restaurant photographed EIGHT signature dishes across TWO services under different mixed lighting, and the photographer left a neutral 18% grey reference card on the surface at the edge of every frame (standard tethered-shoot practice) so white balance can be reconciled after the fact. The eight-dish count, the two-service lighting split, the in-frame grey card, the per-frame casts, the near-black backdrop, the crop dimensions, and the supplied menu-card template + copy file are enrichment; nothing contradicts the source (dark-mode look, food-photo emphasis, Home/Menu sections, mobile optimization are all from the brief). Concrete parameter values a designer would dial are illustrative, not from the brief.
one_line_ask: Turn OBSIDIA's eight mixed-lighting raw plate shots into one cohesive dark-mode menu set that neutralizes to a single house white point, isolate every menu tile onto one identical near-black backdrop, author the signature dish into a wide hero + mobile crop, vectorize the flat logo for the dark site, and merge the graded tiles + menu copy into the supplied template as a print-ready one-dish-per-page menu.
full_brief:
OBSIDIA is a new dark-room fine-dining restaurant built around a live-fire, octopus-forward Iberian menu. We are building its premium, dark-mode website - Home, an Interactive Food Menu, and a Booking section - and the whole design leans on the food photography, shown dark-mode on desktop and mobile. We are NOT reshooting and we do NOT need the site built here; our own front-end developer handles the layout. We need a retoucher to turn our raw plate shots into a polished, cohesive dark-mode image suite plus a print-ready menu.

What you're given: eight raw signature-dish captures, shot across two different services under different mixed lighting, so they do NOT match out of camera. On the surface at the edge of every frame the photographer left a neutral 18% grey reference card as a white-balance reference - use it, then keep it out of the finals. The signature octopus frame also came in a few degrees off level. We also supply our flat raster logo, an authored dark-mode menu-card InDesign template with live fields and an image frame, and the menu copy as a data file.

The bar - this is the whole job: the menu has to read as ONE room. Every dish must resolve to the SAME house look - a moody dark-mode grade where the neutral grey card in each frame lands truly neutral (no residual warm or cool cast) at one common white point, the food staying appetizing and dark but not muddy, with speculars intact and no channel crushed to pure black. Because the frames start from different casts and different exposures, matching the OUTPUT means each frame needs its OWN correction; a set 'auto-fixed' frame-by-frame will not agree at the grey cards and we will reject it. Every menu tile must sit on ONE identical near-black backdrop so the grid is seamless. The signature dish must also carry to a wide cinematic hero with clean headline space and a mobile crop. The logo must come back as a crisp vector for the dark site. Finally, assemble the graded tiles and our menu copy into the supplied template as a print-ready menu, one dish per page.

Deliverables: (1) the signature octopus dish as a wide 21:9 dark-mode hero banner and a 9:16 mobile crop, straightened and graded to the house look; (2) eight square menu tiles, each graded to the house look and isolated onto one identical near-black backdrop; (3) the logo as a clean, crisp SVG for retina use on the dark site; (4) a print-ready menu PDF built from the supplied template, one dish per page; (5) a short sheet listing, per image, the white-balance (temperature / tint), exposure, and black-point values you dialed, so we can confirm the set was matched to one target rather than eyeballed frame by frame.

inputs.name: raw_octopus_signature.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal restaurant food photograph, raw unretouched DSLR look, a signature charred octopus tentacle coiled over smoked-paprika potato puree with drizzled olive oil and microgreens on a dark hand-thrown ceramic plate, set on a matte mid-charcoal linen surface under warm mixed tungsten dinner lighting (~3200K, strong warm/amber cast), slightly underexposed and flat contrast as if straight off the camera, horizon tilted about 4 degrees, a small neutral 18% grey reference card resting on the linen at the far LEFT edge of the frame, visible char marks, oil sheen and ceramic grain, candid documentary food shot, no text, 3:2 landscape, ~4000x2667.
inputs.realism_notes: The SIGNATURE frame: it establishes the house look AND is the hero source AND its own menu tile. Deliberately tilted ~4deg so auto_straighten has real work; warm tungsten (~3200K) + slightly underexposed so the correct move is COOL the WB toward neutral and LIFT exposure a touch - these reported numbers ARE the shared target. Shot on a MID-charcoal linen (not already near-black) that still contrasts with the lighter plate/food, so the tile knockout has a clean edge yet the graded hero reads dark-mode; the grey card sits far LEFT so it is neutralized first and then cropped out when the plate is offset RIGHT for the 21:9 hero, and removed by the tile knockout. Real food micro-detail, no CGI gloss.

inputs.name: raw_ribeye.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal restaurant food photograph, raw unretouched look, a sliced dry-aged ribeye with a smear of bordelaise, charred shallot and sea-salt flakes on a dark slate board over a pale oak surface, warm mixed tungsten dinner lighting (~3200K, warm amber cast), slightly underexposed, real rendered fat and meat fiber, a small neutral 18% grey reference card on the oak at the edge of the frame, candid documentary food shot, no text, ~3200x3200 square.
inputs.realism_notes: Session-A warm dish. Same warm cast as the signature but a slightly different exposure, so its correction toward the common target is close to the signature's but NOT identical - tests whether the agent reasons per-frame rather than copying the signature's numbers. Pale-oak surround gives the knockout a clean edge.

inputs.name: raw_grilled_prawns.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal restaurant food photograph, raw unretouched look, three grilled head-on red prawns with charred lemon and aioli on a dark ceramic plate over a pale marble counter, warm tungsten dinner lighting (~3100K, warm cast) that is also noticeably BRIGHTER than the plated mains, real shell sheen and grill marks, a small neutral 18% grey reference card on the marble at the edge of the frame, candid documentary style, no text, ~3200x3200 square.
inputs.realism_notes: Session-A warm dish but BRIGHTER than the plates - so it needs the warm-to-neutral WB correction AND a downward exposure nudge, unlike the ribeye which needs a slight lift. Two warm frames that still take different corrections. Bright wet shell speculars must not blow when it hits the shared black-floor.

inputs.name: raw_lamb_chop.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal restaurant food photograph, raw unretouched look, two pink-centred grilled lamb chops with romesco and burnt scallion on a dark plate over a walnut surface, warm mixed tungsten dinner lighting (~3300K, deep warm cast), distinctly UNDER-exposed and shadowy, real char and juice, a small neutral 18% grey reference card on the walnut at the edge of the frame, candid documentary style, no text, ~3200x3200 square.
inputs.realism_notes: Session-A warm dish, the darkest of the warm set - needs the warm-to-neutral WB correction AND a stronger exposure LIFT while still seating the shared near-black floor without crushing the already-dark shadows to zero. A frame where over-lifting muddies the food and under-lifting misses the common white point.

inputs.name: raw_roasted_cauliflower.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal overhead food photograph, raw unedited look, a whole roasted cauliflower steak with tahini, pomegranate and herbs on a grey ceramic plate over a light limewashed board, cooler prep-kitchen daylight from a window (~5600K, distinctly cooler and brighter than the dinner-service shots), natural soft shadows, real char and seed detail, a small neutral 18% grey reference card on the board at the edge of the frame, candid documentary style, no text, ~3200x3200 square.
inputs.realism_notes: Session-B COOL dish. Cooler AND brighter than the signature, so the correct move is the OPPOSITE of the warm frames - WARM the WB toward the target and pull exposure DOWN. The frame most likely to expose a naive 'same numbers for all' or per-image auto-tone approach, whose cool cast would survive.

inputs.name: raw_tuna_crudo.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal food photograph, raw unedited look, ruby tuna crudo slices with citrus, chilli oil and micro-herbs on a pale ceramic plate over a white marble counter, cool prep-kitchen daylight (~5800K, clearly cool/blue cast), the brightest frame of the set, glossy specular sheen on the fish and oil, a small neutral 18% grey reference card on the marble at the edge of the frame, candid documentary style, no text, ~3200x3200 square.
inputs.realism_notes: Session-B cool dish, the coolest and brightest of all - so the correct grade applies the LARGEST warm WB shift and the biggest exposure pull-down, protects the blown-risk speculars on the oiled fish, and still lands the grey card on the common white point and the surround on the common floor. Its pale plate and oil sheen show any residual blue cast plainly.

inputs.name: raw_mushroom_risotto.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal food photograph, raw unedited look, a creamy wild-mushroom risotto with shaved parmesan and thyme in a shallow dark bowl over a pale linen surface, cool prep-kitchen daylight (~5400K, cool neutral cast), slightly bright and FLAT low-contrast, real creamy texture and mushroom detail, a small neutral 18% grey reference card on the linen at the edge of the frame, candid documentary style, no text, ~3200x3200 square.
inputs.realism_notes: Session-B cool dish. Cool cast + slightly bright + flat contrast, so warm the WB toward the target, ADD contrast, and seat the black-floor at the house level. Its correction differs again from the cauliflower's because its cast and its flatness differ - copying one cool frame's numbers onto another still misses.

inputs.name: raw_chocolate_tart.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal overhead flat-lay food photograph, raw unedited look, a dark-chocolate ganache tart dusted with cocoa, a single fig quarter and gold leaf on a dark slate over a pale concrete surface, cooler prep-kitchen daylight (~5500K, cool cast, bright and even), real crumb and glossy ganache sheen, a small neutral 18% grey reference card on the concrete at the edge of the frame, candid documentary style, no text, ~3200x3200 square.
inputs.realism_notes: Session-B cool dish with a very DARK subject on a pale surround - warm the WB and pull down, but the dark ganache is the frame where crushing the black-floor to pure zero would swallow the tart's own form, so the deep-not-clipped rule bites hardest here. A different correction again from the other cool frames.

inputs.name: obsidia_logo_flat.png
inputs.gen_prompt: A minimalist restaurant logo mark on a plain flat off-white background: a single SOLID-FILLED monoline-thick octopus silhouette (a compact filled shape, NO thin open strokes, NO enclosed interior counters or holes) in solid warm-gold (#C9A24B), perfectly flat vector-style with crisp clean edges, no gradients, no shadow, no photographic texture, generous margin around the mark, centered, delivered as a 1024x1024 flat RASTER PNG (intentionally raster, slightly soft edges) so it must be re-vectorized.
inputs.realism_notes: Supplied as a flat raster PNG (not vector) so image_vectorize has a genuine reason to run. Deliberately a SOLID-FILLED silhouette with NO enclosed counters, because the mark ships onto a near-black site: a wordmark or ringed mark with enclosed counters, knocked via remove_background then vectorized, keeps its counters filled with the crisped-to-white ground and would read wrong on dark, so the honest dark-ground-safe deliverable is an open, counter-free filled glyph. Flat off-white ground makes the drop-out-to-transparency + trim-to-bounds prep meaningful before tracing.

inputs.name: obsidia_menucard_template.indd
inputs.gen_prompt: A genuine authored single-page dark-mode InDesign menu-card template (NOT a converted PDF): near-black (#0B0B0D) page background, one large square image frame positioned upper/centre bound to an @tile_image data-merge image column, and live data-merge text fields <<dish_name>>, <<dish_desc>>, <<price>> set in an elegant high-contrast serif with warm-gold accents, print bleed and margins set. One card per page.
inputs.realism_notes: A real .indd with live <<fields>> and an @-prefixed image frame so document_merge_data_layout binds both text and the produced tile images (image binding is only in _layout, never in _vector). Near-black page ground matches the tiles' #0B0B0D backdrop so a knocked tile sits seamlessly edge-to-edge on the card. Authored template, never convert_pdf_to_indd, so field binding actually works.

inputs.name: obsidia_menu_copy.csv
inputs.gen_prompt: An 8-row CSV, one row per dish, columns: dish_name, dish_desc, price, tile_image. dish_name/dish_desc/price carry the menu copy for the eight dishes; tile_image holds the @-path to each dish's finished near-black menu tile. Row order sets page order, signature octopus first.
inputs.realism_notes: One record per dish; feeds document_merge_data_layout to emit one card per page (page-count = row-count = 8). The @tile_image column resolves to the eight knocked-and-graded tiles the workflow produces - the merge's only image binding. Columns carry data/goals only, no per-frame diagnosis.

outputs.name: hero_banner_ultrawide.png
outputs.spec: Full-bleed desktop dark-mode HERO, 3440x1440 (21:9), straightened and graded to the OBSIDIA house look (grey card neutralized to the common white point on the retained master; surround floored at the common near-black level, deep but not clipped to 0; the plate lifted to read off the dark surround), an off-center letterbox crop of the native 3:2 signature frame so the plate sits RIGHT and the existing dark surround forms clean headline negative space on the LEFT, grey card cropped out of frame, existing pixels only (honest downscale, no canvas-extend, no upscale), sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: hero_mobile_vertical.png
outputs.spec: Full-bleed mobile Home crop, 1080x1920 (9:16), subject-aware crop of the full-res graded signature master (existing pixels only, honest downscale from the ~4000x2667 source, no upscale, no canvas-extend), grey card out of frame, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: menu_tile_octopus.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), signature octopus isolated onto the uniform near-black (#0B0B0D) backdrop via remove_background({backgroundColor}), graded to the house look at the common white point, grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG. Also the @tile_image for the merge (page 1).

outputs.name: menu_tile_ribeye.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), graded to MATCH the house look at the common white point, isolated onto the SAME uniform #0B0B0D backdrop via remove_background({backgroundColor}), grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: menu_tile_prawns.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), graded to MATCH the house look at the common white point (speculars protected), isolated onto the SAME uniform #0B0B0D backdrop, grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: menu_tile_lamb.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), graded to MATCH the house look at the common white point (shadows lifted but floor not crushed to 0), isolated onto the SAME uniform #0B0B0D backdrop, grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: menu_tile_cauliflower.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), graded to MATCH the house look at the common white point (warmed and pulled down from a cool/bright daylight raw), isolated onto the SAME uniform #0B0B0D backdrop, grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: menu_tile_crudo.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), graded to MATCH the house look at the common white point (strongest warm correction, highlights on oiled fish protected), isolated onto the SAME uniform #0B0B0D backdrop, grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: menu_tile_risotto.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), graded to MATCH the house look at the common white point (warmed, contrast added from a flat cool raw), isolated onto the SAME uniform #0B0B0D backdrop, grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: menu_tile_tart.png
outputs.spec: Square 1:1 menu tile (~1500x1500), graded to MATCH the house look at the common white point (dark subject held off pure black, deep-not-clipped floor), isolated onto the SAME uniform #0B0B0D backdrop, grey card removed by the knockout, sRGB PNG.

outputs.name: logo_mark.svg
outputs.spec: Clean single-color vector logo mark (solid counter-free octopus glyph) as crisp SVG for retina/responsive use on the dark site, produced by flat-ground drop-out to transparency, then trim-to-bounds, then raster-to-vector trace; reads correctly on the near-black ground because it is a filled silhouette with no enclosed counters.

outputs.name: menu_cards.pdf
outputs.spec: Print-ready dark-mode menu PDF authored by merging the 8-row menu-copy CSV into the supplied .indd template: ONE dish per page (page-count = row-count = 8, page 1 = signature octopus), each page binding <<dish_name>>/<<dish_desc>>/<<price>> and placing that dish's near-black-backdrop tile in the card's @tile_image frame, exported at press resolution with the template's bleed/margins. The whole merged document is exported as one PDF (no per-record named file).

outputs.name: grade_report.txt
outputs.spec: A plain parameter sheet the agent authors and returns: for each of the eight dishes, the white-balance temperature and tint, the exposure offset, and the black-point value that were APPLIED, plus the single common house-target white point and black-floor level all eight were matched to. This is the acceptance artifact - it makes 'the set is matched to one target' checkable and the per-frame corrections must be non-identical across the warm vs cool frames. It reports the settings the agent chose, never a measured/recovered pixel value.

connector_workflow.inputs_from: raw_octopus_signature.jpg, raw_ribeye.jpg, raw_grilled_prawns.jpg, raw_lamb_chop.jpg, raw_roasted_cauliflower.jpg, raw_tuna_crudo.jpg, raw_mushroom_risotto.jpg, raw_chocolate_tart.jpg, obsidia_logo_flat.png, obsidia_menucard_template.indd, obsidia_menu_copy.csv
connector_workflow.note: Bring the eight raw plate captures, the flat logo, the authored menu-card template and the menu copy file into the working project in one load so every edit runs against real asset references. Plumbing only - not the difficulty.
Level the off-level horizon on the signature frame before any grading or reframing so the later off-center hero crop is measured against a true horizon. Consumes the uploaded signature capture.

ESTABLISH the OBSIDIA house look on the signature frame and record it as the target the other seven must hit. Using the in-frame neutral grey card as the reference, set temperature and tint to drive that card to true neutral, then build the dark-mode tonality from primitives: seat the darkest surround at the house near-black floor (deep, held off zero), protect the specular highlights, lift shadows only enough to keep food out of mud, add measured contrast, clarity and vibrance. A reasoned authored grade, NOT a preset and NOT auto-tone. The agent must report the temp/tint/exposure/black chosen here - they define the common target. Consumes step 2.

Add the signature move that makes the look the agent's own: a bounded, moderate per-band HSL pass that enriches the food's warm tones and deepens the surround toward a cool near-black while riding the original luminosity - a restrained adjacent-hue/saturation/luminance shift, never a near-complementary rotation. This authored look is part of the shared house target every tile must reach. Consumes step 3.
Select the plated dish on the graded signature frame to drive a subject-only lift. Semantic subject selection (allowed); returns a mask URI. Consumes step 4.

Masked selective edit: apply a small exposure/clarity/vibrance lift to the plate subject ONLY, using step 5's mask, so the dish reads off the dark surround while the near-black floor set earlier is left untouched. image_apply_adjustments accepts a mask, so this is a genuine local edit, not a whole-image push that would also lift the surround and break the house floor. signature_master is the retained card-bearing neutralized+graded master the grader checks neutrality on. Consumes the step-4 image + step-5 mask.

Honest off-center letterbox of the graded 3:2 master to 21:9: crop with the plate offset RIGHT so the existing dark surround on the LEFT becomes clean headline negative space, dropping the far-left grey card out of frame in the same move, and downscale to exactly 3440x1440. Existing pixels only - the canvas is never grown and no pixels are invented. DELIVERABLE hero_banner_ultrawide.png. Consumes step 6.

Subject-aware 9:16 crop of the SAME full-res graded master resized to exactly 1080x1920, grey card outside the crop. Cropping from the full-res master rather than the already-cropped 21:9 banner keeps the target gen-free (honest downscale, no upscale, no canvas-extend). DELIVERABLE hero_mobile_vertical.png. Consumes step 6.

Isolate the plated dish and replace the outer surround with the uniform near-black #0B0B0D in one operation via remove_background({backgroundColor}). This is the CORRECT isolate-onto-solid-ground path - NOT select->invert->fill and NOT a whole-image color_overlay. It removes the edge grey card along with the surround, so grade neutrality is judged on signature_master, not here. Consumes step 6.
Square the knocked signature dish to ~1500x1500 (downscale of existing pixels). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_octopus.png and the page-1 @tile_image for the merge. Consumes step 9.

Grade the ribeye frame to the SAME target set in step 3, reasoning its OWN correction: neutralize its in-frame grey card and dial THIS frame's temperature/tint/exposure/black from its card and histogram, then seat the shared near-black floor and the house curve. Do not copy another frame's numbers. Report the applied values. ribeye_graded is the retained card-bearing master graded here. Consumes the uploaded ribeye.

Isolate the dish and fill the surround with the SAME #0B0B0D via remove_background({backgroundColor}) so the tile matches the grid. Grey card removed here; neutrality judged on the step-11 master. Consumes step 11.
Square to ~1500x1500 (downscale). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_ribeye.png and a merge @tile_image. Consumes step 12.

Grade the prawns frame to the common target, reasoning its OWN correction from its in-frame grey card and histogram, seating the shared floor and house curve while protecting its speculars. Report the applied values; they must not be a copy of another frame's. prawns_graded is the retained card-bearing master. Consumes the uploaded prawns.
Isolate and fill the surround with the SAME #0B0B0D via remove_background({backgroundColor}). Grey card removed here. Consumes step 14.
Square to ~1500x1500 (downscale). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_prawns.png and a merge @tile_image. Consumes step 15.

Grade the lamb frame to the common target, reasoning its OWN correction from its in-frame grey card and histogram - seat the shared floor without crushing its already-dark shadows to zero, and land its grey card on the common white point. Report the applied values. lamb_graded is the retained card-bearing master. Consumes the uploaded lamb.
Isolate and fill the surround with the SAME #0B0B0D via remove_background({backgroundColor}). Grey card removed here. Consumes step 17.
Square to ~1500x1500 (downscale). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_lamb.png and a merge @tile_image. Consumes step 18.

Grade the cauliflower frame to the common target, reasoning its OWN correction from its in-frame grey card and histogram, then seat the shared floor and house curve so a bright daylight frame reads as the same moody room. Report the applied values; they must not be a copy of the warm frames'. cauliflower_graded is the retained card-bearing master. Consumes the uploaded cauliflower.
Isolate and fill the surround with the SAME #0B0B0D via remove_background({backgroundColor}). Grey card removed here. Consumes step 20.
Square to ~1500x1500 (downscale). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_cauliflower.png and a merge @tile_image. Consumes step 21.

Grade the crudo frame to the common target, reasoning its OWN correction from its in-frame grey card and histogram - the strongest correction of the set - while protecting the blown-risk speculars and still landing its grey card on the common white point and its surround on the common floor. Report the applied values. crudo_graded is the retained card-bearing master. Consumes the uploaded crudo.
Isolate and fill the surround with the SAME #0B0B0D via remove_background({backgroundColor}). Grey card removed here. Consumes step 23.
Square to ~1500x1500 (downscale). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_crudo.png and a merge @tile_image. Consumes step 24.

Grade the risotto frame to the common target, reasoning its OWN correction from its in-frame grey card and histogram, adding the contrast a flat frame needs while seating the shared floor and house white point. Report the applied values; they must differ from the other cool frames'. risotto_graded is the retained card-bearing master. Consumes the uploaded risotto.
Isolate and fill the surround with the SAME #0B0B0D via remove_background({backgroundColor}). Grey card removed here. Consumes step 26.
Square to ~1500x1500 (downscale). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_risotto.png and a merge @tile_image. Consumes step 27.

Grade the tart frame to the common target, reasoning its OWN correction from its in-frame grey card and histogram - hold the very dark subject off pure black so the deep-not-clipped floor keeps the tart's form, while landing its grey card on the common white point. Report the applied values. tart_graded is the retained card-bearing master. Consumes the uploaded tart.
Isolate and fill the surround with the SAME #0B0B0D via remove_background({backgroundColor}). Grey card removed here. Consumes step 29.
Square to ~1500x1500 (downscale). DELIVERABLE menu_tile_tart.png and a merge @tile_image. Consumes step 30.
Drop the flat off-white ground of the logo to transparency so the mark sits cleanly on the dark site. Ground drop-out, no reconstruction. Consumes the uploaded logo.

Prep-before-trace: trim the transparent mark to its own tight bounds so the vectorize step traces only the glyph, not empty canvas. Tracing the untrimmed frame wastes trace resolution and can leave a stray border path. Consumes step 32.

Vectorize the trimmed transparent mark to crisp SVG for retina/responsive use on the dark site. The mark is a solid filled silhouette with no enclosed counters, so the trace reads correctly on the near-black ground (no white-filled counters). DELIVERABLE logo_mark.svg. Consumes step 33.

connector_workflow.inputs_from: assets_uploaded, menu_tile_octopus, menu_tile_ribeye, menu_tile_prawns, menu_tile_lamb, menu_tile_cauliflower, menu_tile_crudo, menu_tile_risotto, menu_tile_tart
connector_workflow.note: Merge the 8-row menu-copy CSV into the authored .indd template: bind <<dish_name>>/<<dish_desc>>/<<price>> per row and resolve the @tile_image column to each dish's near-black-backdrop tile, placed in the card's image frame. Produces an 8-page merged document (one dish per page, page-count = row-count; image binding lives only in _layout, never _vector). Consumes the uploaded template + copy file and the eight tiles.

Export the WHOLE merged 8-page document to one print-ready PDF (one menu card per page; page 1 = the signature octopus). document_render_layout exports the entire merged document - no per-record named export. DELIVERABLE menu_cards.pdf. Consumes step 35.

chaining_note: Strict output-to-input chaining across three tributaries that converge on one cohesive dark-mode suite plus a print menu. SIGNATURE tributary (establishes the target AND feeds hero + tile): upload (1) -> auto_straighten (2) -> image_apply_adjustments (3, the REFERENCE house grade: grey card neutralized to the common white point, surround floored at the common near-black level, dark-mode curve - this frame's reported temp/tint/exposure/black ARE the target) -> image_adjust_hsl (4, the bounded authored signature look, part of the shared target) -> select_subject (5) -> masked image_apply_adjustments (6, subject-only plate lift using the step-5 mask = signature_master, the retained card-bearing master) -> off-center letterbox crop to 3440x1440 (7, hero_banner_ultrawide, card cropped out) and 9:16 crop to 1080x1920 (8, hero_mobile_vertical, from the full-res master) and remove_background({#0B0B0D}) knockout (9) -> square 1500 (10, menu_tile_octopus). SEVEN MENU tributaries each fan out from assets_uploaded and each reason a DIFFERENT correction to the SAME target before an identical-backdrop knockout and square resize: ribeye (11->12->13), prawns (14->15->16), lamb (17->18->19), cauliflower (20->21->22), crudo (23->24->25), risotto (26->27->28), tart (29->30->31). Every tile's grade step retains a card-bearing master (grader checks neutrality there) and every knockout uses remove_background({backgroundColor:#0B0B0D}) - never select->invert->fill - so all eight share one identical backdrop. LOGO tributary: remove_background white drop-out (32) -> crop_to_bounds prep (33) -> vectorize (34, logo_mark.svg). CONVERGENCE: the eight finished tiles + the uploaded template and copy file feed document_merge_data_layout (35, 8 rows -> 8 pages, @tile_image bound) -> document_render_layout (36, one press PDF, page 1 = signature).
